services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 20.6 on 31 October 2026, it is above its five-year norm; it has eased slightly from 20.9 a month earlier but risen from 16.8 three months ago and -22.1 six months ago. ABS mining capex expectations is the biggest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the biggest negative (-5.0).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of listed inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At +35.0 in November 2026, it is above its five-year norm; it has eased slightly from +35.7 a month ago but risen from +29.4 three months ago and +10.7 six months ago. US new orders for iron and steel mills is the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-10.4); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -18.3 in November 2026, it is below its 5-year norm; it improved from -24.1 three months earlier but slipped from -16.7 a month earlier. AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-24.2), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive contributor (+5.9); tungsten policy flags are excluded pending sufficient history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 6 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 4 commissioned cells, with $7.2 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised where stated. Over the past six months, it added these positions, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and operational first cell, a second Komatsu agreement and cell order, and a Metal 7 collaboration agreement.
